major_cooldowns.name: Colossus Smash
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Keep on cooldown at all times as the spec's central debuff window; never delay it without a strong reason such as an incoming add wave, since delaying it desyncs every other cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Warbreaker
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: When talented this replaces Colossus Smash, applying the same armor-shred debuff to all nearby targets; use it on cooldown exactly as you would Colossus Smash (talent_gated alternative to Colossus Smash).

major_cooldowns.name: Avatar
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press shortly before or together with Colossus Smash so its damage bonus overlaps the debuff window; Anger Management cooldown reduction keeps it roughly aligned with Colossus Smash, so use it on cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Bladestorm
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Used by Slayer builds during the Colossus Smash window for single- and multi-target damage; its unique cooldown reduction means it will not always realign, so plan whether to use or save it before each Colossus Smash.

major_cooldowns.name: Ravager
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Colossus builds drop it just before Colossus Smash so its ticks land inside the debuff window; talent_gated since not every build takes it.

major_cooldowns.name: Demolish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Colossus hero-talent finisher used during Colossus Smash at 10 stacks of Colossal Might, optionally delayed to the last seconds of the debuff to build extra stacks; talent_gated to the Colossus tree.

major_cooldowns.name: Champion's Spear
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: A talented class-tree throw used inside the Colossus Smash window for burst and to tether enemies in place; talent_gated since it is an optional class talent (best-guess timing, primarily a damage cooldown despite its utility framing).

major_cooldowns.name: Sweeping Strikes
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: On 2 or more targets, press it to cleave your single-target rotation onto a second enemy; with Broad Strokes talented, only cast it manually after the auto-granted charges expire to avoid overcapping.

defensives.name: Die by the Sword
defensives.usage_rule: Pop proactively before heavy physical or parry-able melee damage; it grants a large parry chance plus damage reduction for 8 seconds.

defensives.name: Rallying Cry
defensives.usage_rule: Use as a raid-wide emergency button before a large group-wide hit, granting you and nearby allies a temporary maximum-health and effective-health buffer.

defensives.name: Spell Reflection
defensives.usage_rule: Press just before a targeted magic cast or projectile to reflect it and reduce incoming magic damage during the short window.

defensives.name: Defensive Stance
defensives.usage_rule: Toggle on during sustained heavy damage for a flat damage reduction, then toggle back to your damage stance once the danger passes.

defensives.name: Impending Victory
defensives.usage_rule: Cast when below full health to deal damage and instantly heal a chunk of your maximum health; talent_gated as it replaces Victory Rush only when talented.

rules.action: Always cast Bladestorm during an active Colossus Smash debuff so its hits are amplified by the armor shred; firing Bladestorm outside the window is a major DPS loss.

rules.description: Avatar with or just before Colossus Smash
rules.action: Press Avatar in the same window as Colossus Smash so its damage bonus overlaps the debuff; let Anger Management keep the two aligned rather than drifting them apart.

rules.description: Keep Colossus Smash and Avatar on cooldown
rules.action: Use Colossus Smash, Avatar, and Bladestorm or Demolish on cooldown as much as possible; delaying any one of them desyncs the rest, so only hold a cooldown for an imminent add wave or burst phase.

rules.description: Maximize uptime and avoid wasting Rage
rules.action: Stay on target to keep auto-attacks flowing since they generate most of your Rage, and spend Rage on Mortal Strike and Execute rather than letting it cap or decay between pulls.

rules.description: Open with Charge into Avatar plus Colossus Smash
rules.action: Open every pull with Charge for the extra Rage, then immediately go into Avatar and Colossus Smash followed by your hero-talent burst (Bladestorm or Demolish) inside the debuff window.

rules.description: Execute only during Sudden Death outside Execute phase
rules.action: Above the Execute health threshold, only cast Execute when Sudden Death procs; otherwise spend Rage on Mortal Strike and Slam, then switch to spamming Execute once the target drops into Execute range.

rules.description: Sweeping Strikes and Cleave at 2+ targets
rules.action: On 2 or more targets, maintain Sweeping Strikes to mirror your single-target damage and weave Cleave into the rotation; on Colossus, keep Rend applied and route Demolish through the Colossus Smash window.

rules.description: Stay in melee and use mobility to keep uptime
rules.action: Use Charge after a target finishes moving and Heroic Leap to exit damage at the last moment, minimizing time off target so Rage generation and GCD usage never stall.

source_summary: Arms Warrior has a relatively flat damage profile that is not concentrated entirely into burst windows, so the defining skill is simply keeping Colossus Smash, Avatar, and the hero-talent cooldown (Bladestorm for Slayer or Demolish for Colossus) on cooldown and overlapped with the Colossus Smash debuff. Cooldowns should be aligned when timers allow but never delayed more than roughly 10-15% of their duration, since losing a full use almost always outweighs the gain from stacking. Between cooldowns, the priority is maximizing target uptime to fuel Rage and avoiding Rage waste so the rotation never stalls.
